content: Each reference includes the authors, title, journal, publication date, volume, issue, and page numbers. These references cover topics such as partial and total laryngectomy, supraglottic and glottic cancer management, neck dissection, oncological and functional outcomes, and complications like pharyngocutaneous fistula. The studies also explore different surgical techniques, including transoral laser microsurgery, robotic surgery, and open-neck approaches, as well as the role of radiotherapy and chemotherapy in laryngeal cancer treatment. Additionally, they discuss prognostic factors, patterns of lymph node metastasis, and the effectiveness of selective neck dissection in various clinical scenarios.
